source: sanitized observations from the local July 14 recording status and logs
expected_future_assertions: Only one recorder wrapper may own the same live source at a time.
A second launch is refused before it writes a media file.
Recording-active state requires a live wrapper, live FFmpeg child, and growing output file.
A stale PID or status file never reports active recording.
Stopping first disables wrapper reconnect, then sends FFmpeg SIGINT, waits for container finalization, and probes every completed segment.
The final receipt records segment paths, byte sizes, durations, process exits, and stop reason.
limitations: This is a sanitized historical fixture, not proof that the current wrapper passes these assertions.
Raw logs and media remain local and immutable.
